auth.note: Request a key from the operator. Calls without a valid key receive 401.

capabilities.description: Place a catering package order with a DayMarket business kitchen for a future date and time. The order enters the standard DayMarket flow: scheduled, then the business confirms and sets the total, then marks it delivered. DayMarket is the merchant of record; the buyer is invoiced. A 15% fulfillment fee is deducted automatically before the business is paid.

errors.meaning: Invalid input: missing field, bad datetime, unknown business or package.
Buyer email has no DayMarket account, or business/package not found or inactive.
Station not yet provisioned on this deploy.

fees.note: 15% fulfillment fee deducted automatically from the order total before the business is paid. The business net lands in its DayMarket balance on delivery.

capabilities.idempotency: Pass idempotency_key to make retries safe.

business.description: Business slug (e.g. elliannas-donut-shop) or business UUID. Must be an active DayMarket business.

buyer_email.description: Email of the buyer. Must match an existing DayMarket member account; the order is placed under that buyer.

contact.description: Human contact for fulfillment day-of. Name required; email or phone strongly recommended.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key. Retrying with the same key and identical inputs returns the original order instead of creating a duplicate.

package.description: Package UUID or exact package name (e.g. Meeting Box). Must be active.

scheduled_for.description: ISO 8601 datetime the order is needed, e.g. 2026-10-20T09:00:00-05:00. Must be in the future.

capabilities.name: order_catering

duplicate.description: True when the idempotency key matched an earlier order.

total_cents.description: Null until the business confirms and sets the total.

inputs_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request inputs.

capabilities.name: answer_call
capabilities.description: Answer an incoming voice call when the business cannot pick up. v1 plays a greeting and hands the caller to SMS completion; a realtime voice platform can replace the stub (Phase 3). Every answered call is logged as a verification event.

input_schema.description: Twilio voice webhook payload (form-encoded). Signature verified with TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.

errors.meaning: Station not yet provisioned: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN missing.

capabilities.note: v1 is a stub: greeting + SMS handoff. Set VOICE_AGENT_URL to route live calls to a realtime voice platform.

capabilities.name: complete_text_order
capabilities.description: Complete an order over SMS. The agent classifies intent, answers routine questions from the business structured data only (grounding rule), captures orders as structured data, validates deterministically, and either auto-approves, queues for human review, or asks a clarifying question. Truthful confirmations only.

input_schema.description: Twilio SMS webhook payload (form-encoded): From, To, Body, MessageSid. Signature verified with TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN. Replies via TwiML.

capabilities.idempotency: Twilio MessageSid is used as the idempotency key; redelivered webhooks return the original run.
capabilities.grounding: The agent answers only from the business structured data (menu, hours, prices). Anything else becomes: I will have someone text you.

description: Readable Station prototype on DayMarket. AI agents discover catering capabilities here, invoke them with a single POST, and receive a machine-readable confirmation backed by the existing DayMarket order flow (scheduled, business confirms, delivered, automatic fulfillment fee, business cash-out). Built for agents; the agents build for the customer.
verification: Every agent order writes a verification record (timestamp, inputs hash, order id, status). These records are the audit trail for the station and the seed volume for Readable Evals.
